metadata.dcterms:title: SCHUR–WEYL DUALITY IN POSITIVE CHARACTERISTIC
metadata.dcterms:creator: DOTY, STEPHEN
metadata.dcterms:abstract: Complete proofs of Schur–Weyl duality in positive characteristic are scarce in the literature. The purpose of this sur- vey is to write out the details of such a proof, deriving the result in positive characteristic from the classical result in characteristic zero, using only known facts from representation theory.
